split_rule: Dev: prologue and chapters 1-8. Test: chapters 9-10, epilogue, bonus story. Fixed before any question retrieval.
sampling: Convenience sample authored from selected source pages; many chapter openings. Not a random or comprehensive test.
prior_activity: Default indexes were built before this benchmark. Earlier checks used synthetic questions or stored-vector integrity lookups; no story-question benchmark was tuned. The prior CLI smoke query was database setup connectivity smoke check.
metric: One returned chunk must match the gold document ID and physical PDF page and contain a complete registered evidence quote after Unicode NFC/whitespace normalization. No semantic-equivalence judgment.
alternatives: alternative_evidence may list additional gold_source_id/gold_page/evidence_quote records; all must be validated before freezing. No labels are changed after retrieval in this v1 run.

strategy_filters.C: only the filter explicitly supplied by each question; no filter otherwise

holdout_rule: Select on dev first, save the decision, then run all three configurations on test without changing corpus/model/chunking/questions/labels.
limitations: Only five test questions; each changes the test percentage by 20 points.
Single novel and English embedding model.
Same assistant authored the benchmark and implemented evaluation.
Strict registered-quote scoring can miss valid alternative evidence and paraphrases.
No human coherence or grounding scores are inferred.
